title: Fail-closed persistence disable leaves cached SCHC and time capabilities live
description: Python LinkLayer fatal persistence failure clears receipts, authenticated DIO issuances, and the SCHC session manager, but leaves _schc_peer_contexts, _schc_peer_context_issuances, and _key_generations live. _validated_authenticated_peer_schc_context(), accepts_time_generation(), and elevate_time_generation() do not enforce persistence health. A previously issued peer SCHC context or time-generation capability can remain usable after the LinkLayer marks itself permanently disabled. Fix all cached authority revocation paths and add regression tests covering SCHC compression/decompression/session creation and time-generation acceptance/elevation after a persistence write failure.
